info.title: Palworld Server Observatory API
info.description: API consumed by the authenticated dashboard SPA and by the private collector. Public-listener operations use the Django session cookie. Private-listener operations are available only on the isolated ingest listener.

post.description: Starts a short-lived inventory knowledge challenge for the selected public player. Authenticated site access and same-origin Django CSRF validation are required.
Consumes the current question and returns one alternate question from the same private save snapshot.

post.summary: Verify a player character ownership check
post.description: Verifies the one submitted answer and returns a short-lived bearer session. A failed answer consumes the challenge.

cookieAuth.name: sessionid
cookieAuth.description: Authenticated Django session. The site-access middleware also enforces approval, password change and current terms acceptance.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRFToken
csrfToken.description: Django CSRF token required for session-authenticated unsafe requests.

bearerAuth.description: Private API token configured on the isolated ingest listener.

claimBearerAuth.description: Short-lived bearer token issued after a player character ownership check.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated account cannot perform this operation

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the private API limit

UpstreamError.description: The Palworld REST API could not complete the command

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required private API configuration is unavailable

Conflict.description: The requested claim operation cannot be completed in the current challenge state

TooManyRequests.description: The claim endpoint rate limit was exceeded

ClaimCycled.description: An alternate player claim challenge question
